column2: [intro]
In my bathroom, oh la la!
I’ve got a toothbrush, oh la la!
I sing in the shower while I brush away,
It’s my favorite part of the day!
I love the objects, oh la la!
They’re so beautiful, oh la la!
Each thing, big or small
Makes my heart beat, oh la la!
In my kitchen, oh la la!
I’ve got a stylish toaster, oh la la!
I toast bread and make some snacks,
It’s always more fun with my little machine!
I love the objects, oh la la!
They’re so beautiful, oh la la!
Each thing, big or small
Makes my heart beat, oh la la!
